notes.title: The Station VR v1.2 Release
notes.content:
The Station VR v1.2 release notes

- Updated Index controller binding to fix issue with in-game pause menu item selection. Now only the trigger on either left or right controller is used to make a menu item selection, the grip has been disabled. 
- Updated the hand model orientation relative to the controller to be more parallel to the floor. Done to ease the application of the teleportation arc for teleportation movement. 

Virtro

notes.title: The Station VR v1.1 Release
notes.content:
The Station VR v1.1 release notes 

- The Station VR v1.1 has been updated to support a single exe application to allow Vive and Oculus controller users to launch the game from within SteamVR or Library -> PLAY methods and have the controller type automatically detected. Users will note 'TheStationVR_Oculus' folder (SteamLibrary/steamapps/common/The Station VR/TheStationVR_Oculus) from the v1.0 release will now be empty. Continue/Save file information will still be valid (Users/<username>/AppData/LocalLow/The Station Game Ltd/The Station VR/StationSaveData)
- Locomotion and three associated rotation methods are now supported for both Vive and Oculus controllers
- Save game fix to prevent black screen when game loading
- Updated default controller bindings for Vive and Oculus controllers
- Re-centering mapped to controller buttons on the Vive and Oculus controllers

Virtro

notes.title: Prepare for Boarding
notes.content:
Hello everyone!

It's my pleasure to announce that The Station VR is now published and ready for your pleasure..

We had the pleasure of working with Virtro Entertainment to bring the virtual reality version to life and we're so proud of this collaboration. As most of you know, building a game in virtual reality is a massive undertaking and requires a complete overhaul of the project. Many of the sequences, assets and scripts had to be redone and this is why it required a separate product.

We're so excited for you to experience the game in virtual reality!
